exercises.question: Which description gives an evaluation rather than just a feature? [¿Cuál da una valoración y no solo una característica?]
options: La vivienda sería funcional porque necesito espacio para trabajar. [The home would be functional because I need space to work.]
La vivienda tiene dos habitaciones. [The home has two bedrooms.]
La vivienda está en una calle. [The home is on a street.]

exercises.sentence: Prefiero una vivienda que __ funcional porque necesito espacio para trabajar. [I prefer a home that is functional because I need space to work.]
exercises.hint: ser; a home I have not chosen yet
exercises.english: I prefer a home that is functional because I need space to work.
The house I would choose would have a garden, although it would be more expensive.

sentences: La casa tendría un jardín. [The house would have a garden.]
Sería más cara que un piso. [It would be more expensive than a flat.]
Sin embargo, tendría más privacidad. [However, it would have more privacy.]

exercises.question: Why would the speaker prefer a functional home? [¿Por qué preferiría el hablante una vivienda funcional?]
options: Porque necesita espacio para trabajar. [Because they need space to work.]
Porque quiere pagar más alquiler. [Because they want to pay more rent.]
Porque no necesita privacidad. [Because they do not need privacy.]

exercises.sentence: El lugar sería acogedor y tendría suficiente __ para que pudiéramos convivir cómodamente. [The place would be welcoming and have enough privacy so that we could live together comfortably.]
exercises.english: The place would be welcoming and have enough privacy for us to live together comfortably.

exercises.question: What makes the ideal home suitable? [¿Qué hace que la vivienda ideal sea adecuada?]
options: It combines comfort, quiet and a good neighbourhood. [Combina comodidad, tranquilidad y un buen barrio.]
It is necessarily very large. [Necesariamente es muy grande.]
It is isolated from all neighbours. [Está aislada de todos los vecinos.]

exercises.question: Why would the speaker accept a smaller home? [¿Por qué aceptaría el hablante una vivienda más pequeña?]
options: Because size is less important than being functional, comfortable and private. [Porque el tamaño es menos importante que ser funcional, cómoda y privada.]
Because smaller homes always have lower rent. [Porque las viviendas pequeñas siempre tienen un alquiler más bajo.]
Because the neighbourhood does not matter. [Porque el barrio no importa.]

exercises.question: What does «convivir» mean in the story? [¿Qué significa «convivir» en el texto?]
options: to live together [vivir juntos]
to renovate [reformar]
to compare [comparar]

exercises.sentence: La casa que elegiría tendría un jardín, aunque sería más cara que un piso.
options: The house I would choose would have a garden, although it would be more expensive than a flat.
The house I chose had a garden because it was cheaper than a flat.
The house I will choose will have no garden.

exercises.sentence: Prefiero una vivienda que sea funcional porque necesito espacio para trabajar.
options: I prefer a home that is functional because I need space to work.
I preferred a home that was expensive because I needed a garden.
I prefer a home that is large although I do not work there.

exercises.sentence: Aunque no sería muy grande, tendría un entorno tranquilo y estaría bien comunicado.
exercises.english: Although it would not be very large, it would have a quiet setting and good transport links.

exercises.sentence: El lugar sería acogedor y tendría suficiente privacidad para que pudiéramos convivir cómodamente.
options: The place would be welcoming and have enough privacy so that we could live together comfortably.
The place is large and has no privacy because we live separately.
The place would be noisy so that we could live together.
Sería funcional y acogedora, y tendría suficiente privacidad para trabajar en casa. [It would be functional and welcoming, and it would have enough privacy to work at home.]
Sea funcional y acogedora, y tenga suficiente privacidad para trabajar en casa. [It be (subjunctive) functional and welcoming, and it have (subjunctive) enough privacy to work at home.]
Ser funcional y acogedora, y tener suficiente privacidad para trabajar en casa. [To be functional and welcoming, and to have enough privacy to work at home.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué es más importante para ti, el tamaño o el entorno?

options: Prefiero un entorno tranquilo, aunque la vivienda no sea muy grande. [I prefer a quiet environment, although the home may not be very large.]
Prefiero un entorno tranquilo, aunque la vivienda no sean muy grandes. [I prefer a quiet environment, although the home are (plural) not very large (plural).]
Prefiero un entorno tranquilo donde la vivienda no tiene grande. [I prefer a quiet environment where the home does not have large.]
Porque necesito una vivienda donde pueda trabajar y descansar. [Because I need a home where I can work and rest.]
Porque necesito una vivienda quien pueda trabajar y descansar. [Because I need a home who I can work and rest.]
Porque necesito una vivienda donde podré trabajar y descansando. [Because I need a home where I will be able to work and resting.]

template.prompt: Describe your ideal home using a relative clause, a comparison and a reason.
template.answer: Elegiría una vivienda que fuera tranquila y más luminosa que mi piso actual porque necesito descansar bien.

template.prompt: Explain what makes a home suitable for people living together.
template.answer: Para mí, una vivienda adecuada sería funcional y acogedora, con suficiente privacidad para que pudiéramos convivir cómodamente.
